title: Margin-Guided Token Credit for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2611.14015v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, a language model is rewarded for a correct final answer, and GRPO passes that reward to every token of the solution in equal measure. We instead place the credit where the model hesitated, in a method we call MCPO (Margin-Credit Policy Optimization). We measure hesitation by the top-2 margin $M=p_1-p_2$ of the policy's next-token distribution, map it to a score with two fixed thresholds, and spread each solution's advantage over its tokens so that the mean stays unchanged. The margin is read from a forward pass the trainer already performs, so the method needs no extra model evaluation and no batch statistics. We train MiniCPM5-2B-Base with LoRA for 200 steps on 2,048 DAPO-Math problems and evaluate on six competition-math benchmarks. MCPO beats an unmodified GRPO baseline for all five data seeds, by 6.55 points of macro avg@32 on average (95\% CI $[4.1, 9.0]$), and a Qwen3-4B-Base rep

translated_title: 边缘引导的Token信用分配用于可验证奖励的强化学习
translated_abstract: 在可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中，语言模型因产生正确的最终答案而获得奖励，而GRPO会将该奖励均等地传递给解法中的每一个Token。我们转而将信用分配到模型犹豫不决的位置，并将该方法命名为MCPO（Margin-Credit Policy Optimization，边缘信用策略优化）。我们通过策略下一Token分布的前两名概率差 $M=p_1-p_2$ 来衡量犹豫程度，用两个固定阈值将其映射为分数，并将每个解的优势（advantage）分配到其各个Token上，同时保持均值不变。该边缘值可以直接从训练器已经执行的前向传播中读取，因此该方法无需额外的模型评估，也不需要批次统计信息。我们使用LoRA在2,048个DAPO-Math问题上对MiniCPM5-2B-Base进行200步训练，并在六个竞赛数学基准上进行评估。在全部五个数据种子下，MCPO均优于未修改的GRPO基线，macro avg@32平均提升6.55分（95%置信区间 $[4.1, 9.0]$），并在Qwen3-4B-Base的复现实验中（原文在此截断）……
tldr: 提出MCPO方法，利用策略下一Token分布的前两名概率差识别模型犹豫的Token位置，将奖励信用有针对性地集中于这些位置，且无需额外前向传播或批次统计，在六个竞赛数学基准上平均超越GRPO基线6.55分。
en_tdlr: MCPO allocates reward credit to tokens where the model hesitates—measured by the top-2 probability margin in its next-token distribution—requiring no extra forward passes or batch statistics, while outperforming GRPO by 6.55 points on average across six competition-math benchmarks.
